title: Inka calc evidence v1
description: Evidence JSON emitted by a calculation-graph producer (veriq is the first) and read by an inka project. Each target is one verification a `calc:` bind can reference, carried with the reviewable source of its whole definition-level upstream subgraph, the inka nodes that subgraph assumes, and the leaf results the target must satisfy. Target paths are opaque to inka and must be unique within a loaded evidence set; the loader rejects duplicates.

provenance.description: Descriptive metadata such as the evaluated source revision or the capsula run ID. Never used for evaluation; unknown keys are permitted and ignored.

path.description: The target verification's path in the producer's graph, referenced by `calc:` in a bind. For veriq it is `Scope::?name`.

definitions.description: The target's definition-level upstream subgraph, the target itself included: every root model, calculation and verification it depends on, each once. Paths are unique within a target.

path.description: The definition's path in the producer's graph, e.g. `Power::$Config`, `Power::@budget`, `Power::?verify_margin`.

kind.description: What the definition is. Presentation metadata; it does not enter the interface hash.

source.description: Human-reviewable source string of the definition, CRLF/LF as produced (the consumer normalizes CRLF to LF before hashing). Nothing else is normalized: comments and formatting are content.

assumes.description: The inka nodes this target's upstream subgraph assumes: the set-style union over the definitions' declared assumptions, deduplicated. Each entry is a fully-qualified inka node ID (`namespace::id`, or a bare `id` for a root-level node). The IDs are resolved by inka against the argument; the referenced nodes' contract text fills the bind hash's assumption slot.

leaves.description: The required leaf results of the target verification: one entry per leaf of its output (a scalar verification has one leaf, identified by the target path). Every leaf is required for the target to pass; omitting `result` declares a leaf whose result is missing. Leaf IDs are unique within a target.

result.description: The verification outcome at this leaf.

valid.description: Whether the producer's own validity conditions hold for the target (for veriq: every verification the subgraph marks with `@vq.assume` passed). A target with `valid: false` does not pass, whatever its leaf results.

xfail.description: Whether the producer marks the target as an expected failure. An expected failure never passes; it is reported as such. Defaults to false.
